description: NEW in Postman v4 (2026-09-07). Looks up existing patient record(s) by phone number and returns their patientid, which post_schedule.php accepts to attach a booking directly to that patient instead of creating a lead/agenda insertion.

request_body.phone: string - patient phone number to search (Postman example: 0000000002)

response.status_200_not_found_note: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-07 (via n8n, phone 0770000000 which only ever had leads). A phone that only has Agenda/lead bookings has NO patient record -> NOTFOUND. Leads do not create patients.

status_200_found.name: Paciens Teszt
status_200_found.patientid: <opaque base64-like id, '=' padding replaced by ',' e.g. ends with ','>

response.status_200_found_note: VERIFIED LIVE 2026-09-07 with the CRM test patient 'Paciens Teszt' (#1867, phone 123123123). Array of {name, phone, patientid}. Only CRM patients are returned; phones that only have leads -> NOTFOUND.

notes: Returns PII (patient identities by phone). Same handling rule as get_schedule.php: never store real responses in the repo.

Voice-agent use: after collecting phone + full name, call get_patient.php; if exactly one result matches the spoken name, pass its patientid to post_schedule.php (real appointment). If no match, book without patientid (lead). If several match and none/many fit the name, ask the caller to disambiguate rather than guessing - a wrong patientid silently books for the wrong person since name/phone are ignored.
